[quote=cordone;58019573][b]Question of the Day #8:[/b]

[i]What administrative divisions does your nation divide itself up into? (Counties, Province, Govenorates, etc[/i][/quote]

These divisions include:

Provinces: Ekpatanus consists of several provinces, each headed by a governor appointed by the monarchy. The provinces work under a unified national government to maintain coherence and national identity. For example:

Mountain Province
Coastal Province
Central Province
  
Counties: Each province is further divided into counties, which handle local governance and administrative tasks. Counties are also overseen by officials appointed by the provincial government.

Sections: Each county is divided into smaller sections or districts to facilitate local administration.

Villages and Towns: At the grassroots level, each section includes several villages and small towns, where the daily lives of people take place.

This administrative structure allows Ekpatanus to maintain a centralized authority while providing necessary services and governance to its citizens, reflecting its unified national identity under a semi-constitutional monarchy.
